segments.text: For the July 2026 Johns Hopkins Technology Ventures room, identify which public technology disclosures warrant the next translation investigation. The available RS run report describes a 2,117-record catalog and 20 candidate pairs, but the source CSV is missing in this checkout.

Leads include monoscopic endoscope 3D reconstruction paired with low-cost 3D surgical guidance, a motion-triggered retracting endoscope safety system, prosthetic liner EMG electrodes paired with an implantable muscle interface, overlapping intimate-partner-violence safety decision apps, and a nanogel paired with a local brain-treatment nanofiber hydrogel.
Find opportunities by checking technical fit, clinical workflow, user needs, evidence and counterevidence, safety, regulation, licensing overlap, and falsifiable next experiments.
Do not assume combinations are novel or compatible; separate verified claims from hypotheses; preserve disagreement; no minimum breakthrough count.
